[P2] Honor request cancellation after awaiting consent

If a client cancels a `tools/call` while this gate awaits its check or elicitation response, the callback still continues when consent arrives. All three data callbacks ignore the request's abort signal, so a cancelled call can start its query afterward—including when another concurrent call shares and accepts the prompt. Capture each request's cancellation signal and check it after the gate settles, before dispatching any query. Add coverage for cancelling one queued call while another remains active.
